adidas-metalbone-3-5-2026: Head-heavy diamond with plenty of easy power on smashes; defence suffers, so several remove weights.
adidas-metalbone-carbon-ctrl-3-5-2026: Firm, stable control racket that stays manoeuvrable, though some find it short on power.
adidas-metalbone-ctrl-2026: Large, forgiving sweet spot with easy power; the soft, springy face is too bouncy for some.
adidas-metalbone-ctrl-3-4-2025: Very large sweet spot and soft, arm-kind feel; the trampoline effect on blocks is the main drawback.
adidas-metalbone-hrd-plus-3-4-2025: Easy attacking power for strong players; several find it stiff on blocks and some got elbow pain.
babolat-air-viper-2025: Light, fast and strong at the net; the small, punishing sweet spot is the main downside.
babolat-air-viper-2026: Crisp, firm and quick at the net, bigger than the 2025; off-centre hits are still punished.
babolat-viper-soft-juan-lebron-3-0-2026: Powerful head-heavy diamond for overheads, easier to handle than the regular one; some find it hard.
bullpadel-hack-04-hybrid-2025: Dry, firm mix of control and power without much trampoline; a few find it short on power.
bullpadel-neuron-02-edge-2026: Firm, dry racket that most praise for control; the small sweet spot leaves off-centre hits dead.
bullpadel-vertex-04-hybrid-2025: Controlled, comfortable and kind to the arm with a generous sweet spot; power is moderate for some.
bullpadel-vertex-05-geo-2026: Easy, explosive power with decent control for attackers; some find it head-heavy and demanding.
bullpadel-vertex-05-hybrid-2026: Control racket with a large sweet spot and little trampoline; some got elbow pain from the firmness.
head-coello-motion-2026: Forgiving for a diamond, manoeuvrable and low on vibration; a few felt arm or shoulder pain.
head-extreme-motion-2025: Diamond that handles like a rounder shape, with easy overhead power; head-heavy balance irks some.
kuikma-hybrid-pro-2026: Medium-hard, dry and manoeuvrable, rated against pricier rackets; it can punish off-centre hits.
nox-at10-genius-12k-2025: Controlled and manoeuvrable with a gentle effect on the arm; not a power racket for some.
nox-at10-genius-12k-alum-xtrem-2026: Firm, crisp racket with a forgiving sweet spot and quick handling; stiffness divides opinion.
nox-at10-genius-12k-alum-xtrem-lite-2026: Light on the arm, very manoeuvrable and strong in defence; the soft feel limits power on smashes.
nox-ea10-ventus-hybrid-12k-2026: Dry, firm and trampoline-free, a relief after bouncier models; a somewhat smaller sweet spot.
oxdog-hyper-pro-2-0-2026: Dry, firm and low on vibration with strong control; weight and balance often need tuning.
oxdog-ultimate-pro-plus-2025: Attacking racket with strong ball exit and a decent sweet spot for a diamond; the weight tires some.
oxdog-ultimate-tour-x-2026: Light, manoeuvrable diamond with a fairly forgiving sweet spot; a bit less top-end power.
siux-diablo-pro-2026: Light and manoeuvrable with a firm, dry feel and little trampoline; some want more power.
siux-diablo-pro-4-2025: Big, forgiving sweet spot with easy control and help in defence; the glossy paint scratches easily.
siux-electra-pro-st4-2025: Easy power and control at a good price, though feel divides opinion and several report paint chips.
siux-fenix-pro-6-2026: Easy power and strong smashes for technical attackers; head-heavy balance makes defending tiring.
